I am 62, been working these 8 mu for 40 years now. In Quzhou we do wheat-maize double cropping — that's what everyone here does, and the land supports it well with our well irrigation. My two sons are in the city so it's just me and my wife now, but I can still manage 8 mu with some machinery services hired in.

Let me think through this year.

**Winter wheat (8 mu, October to June):**
Last year I got about 500 kg per mu, which is normal for me. I'll plant Jimai 22 again — it's a good improved variety, many neighbors use it, yields well and resists lodging. I buy seed from the county dealer, about 15 kg per mu for drilling.

For fertilizer — at planting I'll put down compound fertilizer (15-15-15) about 40 kg per mu as base, that gives me 6 kg N, 6 kg P, 6 kg K. Then at green-up stage in March I topdress urea about 20 kg per mu, that's another 9 kg N. So total around 15 kg N, 6 kg P, 6 kg K per mu. In Quzhou the soil already has decent phosphorus from years of compound fertilizer, but I still apply because skipping it scares me — a weak crop is worse than spending a few extra yuan.

Irrigation: winter water before freeze, then green-up water, jointing, and grain-filling. So 4 times. Our well water is reliable but electricity costs money, so I don't over-water.

Pesticide: one herbicide spray in spring for broadleaf weeds, one fungicide-insecticide mix at heading for aphids and rust. So 2 applications. If aphids explode I'll do a third.

Tillage: rotary after maize harvest, that's standard here. Plowing deep is too expensive and the rotary cultivator does fine for wheat.

**Summer maize (8 mu, June to October):**
After wheat I plant Zhengdan 958 or similar hybrid, no-till direct seeding into wheat stubble — saves time and moisture. About 4500 plants per mu.

Fertilizer: compound 40 kg per mu at planting (6-6-6 NPK), then urea topdress 25 kg per mu at big flare stage (12 kg N). Total about 18 kg N, 6 kg P, 6 kg K. Maize needs more N than wheat.

Irrigation: if June-July rains are good I only water 2 times (jointing and tasseling). If dry, 3 times. I'll plan for 3.

Pesticide: one spray for armyworm and corn borer at whorl stage, maybe a second if borer pressure is high. Plan 2.

Expected yield: maize around 600 kg per mu, wheat 500 kg per mu. That's what my land gives with decent management.
